content: I tried various methods to remove the rivets and found what worked best for me was to simply get your fingernail under the exposed rivet button and pull it out.  Some of the rivets were hard to get to the back of and it was easier to just get them out from the front.  You too will come to hate the rivets

replies.content: i found it easier to pop them out from underneath.

content: If you're careful enough, you can use flush cutters to also remove the rivets. Beware of scratching the plexiglass and the metal though.
I‘d recommend https://www.printables.com/model/1349886-rivet-extraction-tool for removing the rivets

replies.content: +1 this is the best tool I've found for removing the rivits as well
